title: 第33章 阻敌第34章 这义薄云天的名号难不成是杀出来的
slug: 骂我朝廷鹰犬我乃大秦武圣
content_zh:
张远身后四位军卒，穿板甲，手持长枪，腰间一柄二尺短刀的是随张远出过几次任务的老卒于长龙。
刚才就是于长龙帮张远束甲。
穿锁甲，左手持盾，右手握横刀的是冯成，此时一脸激动。
他没想到张远会让他随行组阵。
还有两位穿了皮甲的军卒，也是新兵，面皮紧绷，背箭囊，手中持弓，背着四柄短枪。
这是一伍配置，也是苍狼战阵的最低搭配。
如果是一什军卒，还会配长斧兵和重盾兵。
再人多，还有重弩。
那可是大杀器。
如此军甲齐备，还只是武卫衙门的皂衣卫，若是边关战卒，重甲，重骑，重刀，军阵集结，就是钢铁长城。
大秦一向军伍隆盛，军卒从甲胄到后勤，都极为重视。
正是如此，才能以武道敌仙魔，以凡人之躯抵挡仙魔侵袭。
“嘭——”
河湾方向，传来巨响。
“有埋伏——”
“官府的拦江索，冲过去。”
“特奶奶的，十几个黑皮狗也敢拦你大爷——”
呼喝之声，在河道上响彻。
船只碰撞声音不断。
永安县的县尉等人面色一变，转身朝着河岸边奔跑过去。

河岸边，军曹神色微沉。
匪寇到来的时间比之前预计的要早，永安县在广济河上准备的拦截船只还未到位。
“阻敌。”军曹口中低喝，向着整束完毕的武卫一挥手。
“诺”张远一抱拳，领着军阵飞奔冲出。
他身后四位军卒紧随，不远处，陈武也领了一队军卒在后面，其他同样组阵的武卒，松散跟上。
另外一边齐俊良所带的第五队，也顺着河湾过去，开始包抄。
前行数百步，已经到大河边上。
一手压腰间雁翎刀柄，一手摸着后腰扣紧的弓弩手柄，张远脚下奔行，目光扫向前方。
河湾处不过二十丈，三艘双桅木船撞在一起。
一条牛筋长索被绷紧，将木船顺水而下的势头阻住。
河岸边，十几位身穿黑色皂衣武袍的军卒手持长弓，隔着五六丈远射箭，将木船上的那些匪寇都压住，不能露头。
大秦不禁江湖刀剑兵器，但军中硬弓百姓不得私藏。
别看河岸边才十几个皂衣卫和衙役，手中有长弓，聚在一处，已经让三艘木船上的匪寇冲不出船舱，只能怒喝咒骂。
此时，两队带甲军卒从河岸边冲来，让那三艘船上的匪寇顿时惊慌。
“快，冲出去斩断拦江索。”
“来几个人，跟我潜水去将那些黑皮狗杀散，若不然一直放箭，兄弟们出不去。”
“冲，带甲战卒若到，我们都得死。”
船舱之中有呼喝之声响起，然后便有人从舷窗中跳出，落在水中。
content_en:
The four soldiers behind Zhang Yuan were wearing plate armor and holding long spears. The one with a two-foot dagger at his waist was Yu Changlong, an old soldier who had accompanied Zhang Yuan on several missions.
Just now it was Yu Changlong who helped Zhang Yuan put on his armor.
Wearing mail armor, holding a shield in his left hand and a horizontal sword in his right hand, Feng Cheng looked excited.
He didn't expect that Zhang Yuan would let him accompany him to form the formation.
There were also two soldiers wearing leather armor, who were also new soldiers. They had tight faces, quivers on their backs, bows in their hands, and four short spears on their backs.
This is a team configuration, and it is also the minimum configuration for the Canglang battle formation.
If it is an army soldier, it will also be equipped with long ax soldiers and heavy shield soldiers.
No matter how many people there are, there are also heavy crossbows.
That's a big killer.
With such a complete army and armor, they are just the soap-clad guards of the Wuwei Yamen. If they are border soldiers, heavy armor, heavy cavalry, heavy swords, and the military formation is assembled, it is the Great Steel Wall.
The Qin Dynasty has always had a prosperous army, and the military attaches great importance to everything from armor to logistics.
It is precisely in this way that one can fight against immortals and demons with martial arts and resist the invasion of immortals and demons with a mortal body.
"Bang——"
There was a loud noise from the direction of the river bend.
"There's an ambush——"
"The government's blocking rope, rush over."
"Damn it, even a dozen black dogs dare to stop your uncle——"
The sound of shouts and shouts resounded on the river.
There was a constant sound of ships colliding.
The expressions of the Yong'an County lieutenant and others changed, and they turned around and ran towards the river bank.
On the bank of the river, the sergeant looked gloomy.
The bandits arrived earlier than previously expected, and the interception boats prepared by Yong'an County on the Guangji River had not yet arrived.
"Stop the enemy." The sergeant shouted in a low voice, waving to the armed guards who had completed their bundles.
"Nuo" Zhang Yuan cupped his fists and led the army to rush out.
Four soldiers followed closely behind him. Not far away, Chen Wu also led a group of soldiers behind, and other soldiers in the same formation followed loosely.
On the other side, the fifth team led by Qi Junliang also followed the bend of the river and began to outflank them.
After walking a few hundred steps, we reached the edge of the river.
With one hand pressing the handle of the Yanling knife at his waist, and with the other hand touching the handle of the crossbow fastened on his waist, Zhang Yuan ran forward and glanced ahead.
At the bend of the river, which was only twenty feet away, three wooden two-masted boats collided.
A long rope of beef tendon was tightened, blocking the momentum of the wooden boat going down the water.
On the river bank, a dozen soldiers wearing black soap robes held long bows and shot arrows from a distance of five to six feet, suppressing the bandits on the wooden boats and preventing them from showing their heads.
The Qin Dynasty could not control the swords and weapons in the rivers and lakes, but the hard bows in the army were not allowed to be kept secretly by the common people.
Don't look at the fact that there are only a dozen Zaoyi guards and government servants on the river bank, with long bows in their hands, gathered in one place, but the bandits on the three wooden boats have been unable to get out of the cabin, and they can only shout and curse angrily.
At this time, two teams of armored soldiers rushed from the river bank, causing the bandits on the three boats to panic.
"Quick, rush out and cut off the rope blocking the river."
"Come a few people and dive with me to kill those black dogs. If you don't keep firing arrows, the brothers won't be able to get out."
"Charge, if the armored soldiers arrive, we will all die."
There were shouts and shouts in the cabin, and then someone jumped out of the porthole and fell into the water.
